roadmaps.title: Frontend Developer
roadmaps.about: Learn to build the part of a website that users see and click.

topics.title: HTML
topics.about: The structure of every web page: headings, links, forms and semantic tags like header, nav and main.

topics.title: CSS
topics.about: Colours, spacing, flexbox and grid. This is how a page gets its look and layout.

topics.title: Git & GitHub
topics.about: Save your work in steps (commits) and share code. Every company expects this.

topics.title: JS Fundamentals
topics.about: Variables, functions, arrays, objects and loops. The base for everything else.

topics.title: DOM & Events
topics.about: Change the page from code and react to clicks, typing and form submits.

topics.title: Fetch & JSON
topics.about: Get data from a server without reloading the page.

topics.title: Vue
topics.about: A beginner-friendly framework that updates the page automatically when your data changes.

topics.title: React
topics.about: The most requested framework in job listings. Build pages from small components.

topics.title: Responsive Design
topics.about: Make pages work on phones, tablets and laptops using media queries.

topics.title: Testing Basics
topics.about: Write small tests so you know your code still works after changes.

topics.title: Deploy a Site
topics.about: Put your project online for free so recruiters can open it.

topics.title: Portfolio Projects
topics.about: Build 2 to 3 projects you can explain fully. This is what interviewers ask about.

roadmaps.title: Full-Stack Developer
roadmaps.about: Build both the website and the server and database behind it.

topics.title: HTML & CSS
topics.about: Page structure and styling. You need these before anything else.

topics.title: JavaScript
topics.about: One language for both the browser and the server.

topics.title: Git & GitHub
topics.about: Version control and teamwork on code.

topics.title: Node.js
topics.about: Run JavaScript outside the browser and build servers.

topics.title: HTTP & REST APIs
topics.about: How browsers and servers talk: methods, status codes and JSON.

topics.title: Express
topics.about: A small library that makes writing routes and APIs shorter.

topics.title: SQL
topics.about: Store and query structured data with SELECT, JOIN and GROUP BY.

topics.title: MongoDB
topics.about: A document database that stores JSON-like data.

topics.title: Connect Front End to API
topics.about: Use fetch to call your own API and show the data on the page.

topics.title: Login & Security
topics.about: Passwords, sessions and common attacks like XSS and SQL injection.

topics.title: Docker
topics.about: Package your app so it runs the same on any computer.

topics.title: API Testing
topics.about: Automatically check that every endpoint returns the right answer.

roadmaps.title: Data Analyst
roadmaps.about: Turn raw data into answers and charts that help people decide.

topics.title: Python Syntax
topics.about: Variables, loops, functions and lists.

topics.title: Files & Functions
topics.about: Read CSV files and organise your code into functions.

topics.title: Jupyter Notebooks
topics.about: Write code and notes together. The standard tool for analysis.

topics.title: pandas
topics.about: Load, filter, group and clean tables of data.

topics.title: NumPy
topics.about: Fast maths on arrays of numbers.

topics.title: SQL
topics.about: Ask questions of a database. Asked in almost every analyst interview.

topics.title: Statistics Basics
topics.about: Mean, median, spread and correlation, explained simply.

topics.title: Data Cleaning
topics.about: Fix missing values, duplicates and wrong types before analysing.

topics.title: Visualization
topics.about: Choose the right chart and make it easy to read.

topics.title: Portfolio Project
topics.about: Analyse a real dataset and write up what you found.

topics.title: Explain Your Findings
topics.about: Practise telling the story of your data in 2 minutes. Use Interview Practice here.

topics.title: Excel Basics
topics.about: Pivot tables and formulas. Still used everywhere in business.

roadmaps.title: Software Engineer (Placements)
roadmaps.about: The path most campus placement tests and technical rounds follow.

topics.title: Java or C++
topics.about: Pick one language and get comfortable writing programs in it.

topics.title: OOP Concepts
topics.about: Classes, inheritance, polymorphism and encapsulation. Asked in nearly every interview.

topics.title: Problem Solving
topics.about: Solve one small problem every day to build speed.

topics.title: Arrays & Strings
topics.about: The most common coding-test topic. Learn two pointers and sliding window.

topics.title: Stacks, Queues, Lists
topics.about: Know how each works and when to use it.

topics.title: Trees & Graphs
topics.about: Traversals (DFS and BFS), binary search trees and shortest paths.

topics.title: DBMS
topics.about: Normalisation, keys, joins and transactions.

topics.title: Operating Systems
topics.about: Processes, threads, scheduling and deadlocks.

topics.title: Computer Networks
topics.about: OSI model, TCP vs UDP, DNS and HTTP.

topics.title: Aptitude Practice
topics.about: Percentages, time and work, number series and logic puzzles.

topics.title: Mock Interviews
topics.about: Practise answering out loud. Use the Interview tab of this app.

topics.title: Resume & Projects
topics.about: One page, two projects, measurable results. Use the Resume tab of this app.

roadmaps.title: AI / ML Engineer
roadmaps.about: Learn the maths, Python tools and models behind modern AI.

topics.title: Python
topics.about: The main language of AI work. Learn syntax, functions and lists.

topics.title: Maths for ML
topics.about: Vectors, matrices and derivatives. You only need the basics at first.

topics.title: Statistics
topics.about: Probability, mean, variance and distributions.

topics.title: NumPy
topics.about: Fast maths on arrays of numbers.

topics.title: pandas
topics.about: Load, clean and explore tables of data.

topics.title: Matplotlib
topics.about: Draw charts to understand your data.

topics.title: ML Basics
topics.about: Train simple models such as linear regression and decision trees with scikit-learn.

topics.title: Model Evaluation
topics.about: Train/test split, accuracy, overfitting and cross-validation.

topics.title: Practice on Kaggle
topics.about: Short free courses with real datasets.

topics.title: Neural Networks
topics.about: How layers learn, and how to build one.

topics.title: Build a Project
topics.about: Pick a dataset, train a model and explain your results.

topics.title: Run Models Locally
topics.about: Use Ollama to run a language model on your own computer, like this project does.

roadmaps.title: Python Developer
roadmaps.about: Build backend apps, APIs and automation with Python.

topics.title: Python Syntax
topics.about: Variables, loops, functions, lists and dictionaries.

topics.title: OOP in Python
topics.about: Classes, objects and inheritance.

topics.title: Modules & Packages
topics.about: Split code into files and use libraries.

topics.title: Flask
topics.about: A small framework. A good first step for building APIs.

topics.title: Django
topics.about: A bigger framework with login, admin and database tools built in.

topics.title: REST APIs
topics.about: HTTP methods, status codes and JSON.

topics.title: SQL
topics.about: Query and design databases.

topics.title: Django Models
topics.about: Use Python classes to work with database tables.

topics.title: Git & GitHub
topics.about: Save and share your code.

topics.title: Testing with pytest
topics.about: Automatically check your code works.

topics.title: Virtual Environments
topics.about: Keep each project's libraries separate.

topics.title: Deploy a Project
topics.about: Put a Python app online for free so recruiters can try it.
